rules.title: How to Play
rules.rule1: Fill each row, column, and 3×3 box with 1-9
rules.rule2: Numbers in each cage must sum to the cage total
rules.rule3: No duplicate numbers within any cage

difficultyDescriptions.easy: 20 given digits to get you started
difficultyDescriptions.medium: 10 given digits — the cage sums do the work
difficultyDescriptions.hard: No given digits, cage sums only
